title: The armed conflict and the 2016 peace agreement
goal: Report what a commission, a court or a delegate said about the conflict and the peace process, using reported speech.

items: I can report what someone said with *dijo que* and the right tense shift.
I can say what the 2016 agreement created and what the Commission of Truth reported.
I can use the new words for agreement, victim and report.
